title: E-SPN-0195: R and g as one matching table: the register member's NRQED coefficients M1 = m, M2 = tan m, (M2 / M4)^3...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0195 in the spin arena: R and g as one matching table: the register member's NRQED coefficients M1 = m, M2 = tan m, (M2 / M4)^3 = (32/3) tan^2 m + cos 2m / cos^2 m and $c_F$ from its Landau levels, read at five masses, predict a bound pair's excess R - tan m / m with no free parameter (Kronfeld's first-order kinetic mass), compared with E-SPN-0183's measured R at $a_B$ 8 and 12.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
